judgement.reason: It bears on endless punishment, which sits near the question, but it never mentions Origen, universal salvation or any condemnation.
It is Augustine on those who doubt eternal punishment, a nearby topic, and says nothing of Gregory of Nyssa or restoration of all things.
It is from a sermon on John 6 about eating the food that lasts, not the opening of John.
It is about naming people on certificates of peace and says nothing of Matthew 7 or I never knew you.
It tells lay hearers how to live beside bad members of the Church and does not answer whether the communion rite is his body and blood.
